gameName: War of the Ring: Second Edition
firstPlayerRule: In the two-player game, the Free Peoples player takes the first action in the Action Resolution phase. The two sides then alternate actions.
clarifications: Earlier phases handle card draws, the Fellowship, Hunt allocation and rolling Action dice.
In the four-player game, the non-Leading Free Peoples player acts first. On the first turn, that is the Rohan player; Gondor begins with the Leading Player token.
